the aggregation of n TiO2 and mobility of aggregated n TiO2 particles in porous media under high ionic conditions in the presence of organic compounds.
the influence of ionic valence, organic compounds and high ionic strength on the aggregation behaviors and mobility of n-Ti O2 in porous media.
the surface modification of nanoparticles by HA and/or E3 under high ionic conditions and their mobility behaviors in porous media.

the aggregation of n TiO2 in the environment is strongly influenced by the ionic strength and the organic compounds.
